hypothesis: NVIDIAの279B USD supply/capacity commitmentsは、現行のData Center revenue run-rateとgross-profit/cash-generation capacityに対して過大ではなく、期限別にみればFY2027残期間だけがcash coverage上の主な制約である。

decision_rule.use_if: 各主要期限バケットでno-growth Q2 FY2027 run-rateによるgross-profit coverageとreported-FCF coverageがともに1.0x以上。
decision_rule.condition_if: gross-profit coverageは全主要期限で1.0x以上だが、少なくとも1期限でreported-FCF coverageが1.0x未満。
decision_rule.reject_if: 主要期限のいずれかでno-growth gross-profit coverageが1.0x未満、または後続開示がcommitment吸収能力の構造的不足を示す。
decision_rule.unverified_if: commitmentの期限、Q2 revenue/gross margin、またはH1 FCF identityが不足する。

capital_allocation_importance: 前回研究ではNVDA H1 FY2027のcash-conversion headroomがworking-capital timingで大きく変わり得る一方、supply/capacity commitmentsが119B USDから279B USDへ増えたことが独立のdownside conditionとして残った。今回、279B USDを一括額ではなく期限別cash-generation capacityで評価する。
primary_sources: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Form 10-Q, quarter ended 2026-07-26: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000075/nvda-20260726.htm

method.point_in_time: Use only issuer-reported information available through 2026-08-26 and existing canonical FCF identity. No future quarter is used.
method.no_growth_benchmark: Hold Q2 FY2027 quarterly revenue 96.221B USD, GAAP gross margin 75.0%, and H1 FY2027 reported FCF margin 39.302845% constant. Use 2 quarters for remainder FY2027 and 4 quarters for FY2028/FY2029.
method.coverage: coverage = period cash-generation capacity / same-period supply-and-capacity commitment. Gross-profit and FCF coverage are shown separately because supplier commitments are not equivalent to accounting expense or immediate cash payment.
method.alternative: Repeat FCF coverage using the prior-study AR-normalized H1 FCF margin 47.773213% as a sensitivity only, not issuer-reported FCF.
method.risk_metrics: NOT_APPLICABLE: point-in-time fundamental commitment-coverage diagnostic, not a trading-strategy backtest.

benchmark_and_alternative.simple_benchmark: No-growth Q2 FY2027 run-rate using reported H1 FCF margin. This avoids assuming continued 100%+ Data Center growth.
benchmark_and_alternative.alternative_hypothesis: The apparent FY2027 cash shortfall is primarily working-capital timing rather than insufficient unit economics.
benchmark_and_alternative.alternative_result: SUPPORTED CONDITIONALLY: using the prior AR-normalized FCF sensitivity raises remainder-FY2027 FCF coverage from 0.8221x to 0.9993x, nearly 1.0x, but this cash normalization is not yet realized.

verdict.reason: No-growth gross-profit capacity covers the major commitment buckets: 1.57x for remainder FY2027, 3.32x for FY2028 and 3.28x for FY2029. Reported FCF capacity also covers FY2028/FY2029 at 1.74x/1.72x, but remainder FY2027 is only 0.82x. AR-normalized sensitivity reaches 0.9993x but is not realized cash. The 279B USD headline therefore overstates near-term concentration when treated as one lump sum, while the FY2027 cash-timing constraint remains material.
verdict.capital_allocation_implication: Do not treat 279B USD as an immediate one-period liability. Monitor remainder-FY2027 commitment coverage separately. Maintain CONDITION until reported cash conversion or commitment rescheduling/cancellation brings near-term FCF coverage to at least 1.0x; FY2028/FY2029 no-growth coverage is currently above 1.0x.

implementation.delete_or_cleanup: No dedicated code/config/workflow/one-off script created; no cleanup required.

limitations: Supply/capacity commitments are contractual commitments, not equivalent to accounting COGS or a single-date cash payment; coverage ratios are capacity diagnostics, not solvency ratios.
NVIDIA states some supplier agreements may be cancelable, rescheduled or adjustable before firm orders, so 279B USD is not uniformly firm in economic substance.
No-growth Q2 revenue/gross-margin/FCF-margin run-rates are deliberately simple sensitivities, not company guidance for FY2028/FY2029.
AR-normalized FCF is a sensitivity from the prior canonical study, not issuer-reported or guided cash flow.
Customer demand, product transitions, inventory provisions and supplier renegotiation costs can alter realized economics.

Follow-up cash-timing review found no quantified firm/cancellable split or quarterly payment schedule for the 92B USD FY2027 remainder bucket; accounts payable and excess purchase-obligation balances cannot be mapped to it without double-counting risk.
next_high_value_hypothesis: このNVIDIA worklineはQ3 FY2027 actual、firm/cancellable split、supplier payment timing、または92B USD bucketのmaterial revisionまで停止する。新規候補選定では、現在のportfolio allocationに対して独立に判断を変え得る未検証仮説を比較する。

follow_up_cash_timing_decomposition.hypothesis: FY2027残期間92B USD supply/capacity commitmentsを、firm/noncancelable cash-outと変更可能なcapacity reservationへ一次開示だけで分解できる。

precommit_rule.use_if: issuer disclosure identifies the quantified firm/noncancelable amount and payment period, producing an auditable cash-out schedule narrower than the aggregate 92B USD bucket.
precommit_rule.condition_if: a partial quantified split or bounded payment schedule is disclosed, but some material amount remains unmapped.
precommit_rule.reject_if: a proposed balance-sheet proxy cannot be mapped to the 92B USD commitment population or creates double-counting risk.
precommit_rule.unverified_if: firm-order share, cancellable share, or payment timing is not quantified.

source_revision.filing: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Form 10-Q filed 2026-08-26, accession 0001045810-26-000075

disclosure_result.disclosed_statement: Certain supplier agreements may be cancelable, rescheduled, or adjustable for business needs before firm orders; changes may result in additional costs.
disclosure_result.mapping_result: The filing does not map accounts payable, excess inventory purchase obligations, inventory, or unpaid capex to the 92B USD supply/capacity commitment bucket.

benchmark_and_alternative.conservative_benchmark: Continue treating 92B USD as an economic-capacity stress target, not a forecast of same-period cash payment.
benchmark_and_alternative.rejected_proxy: Do not substitute accounts payable 15.059B USD plus excess inventory purchase obligations 2.138B USD for firm cash-out. Their population and overlap with the 92B USD commitment bucket are undisclosed.
benchmark_and_alternative.implication: The prior 0.922762x reported-FCF coverage is a conservative diagnostic under the 92B target. It is not an issuer-reported liquidity or solvency ratio.

verdict.reason: The filing quantifies the fiscal-year aggregate but not the firm/cancellable split or cash-payment dates. Balance-sheet items are real, but cannot be reconciled to the commitment population without unsupported assumptions.
verdict.decision_effect: Do not reduce or increase the 92B USD near-term cash target using balance-sheet proxies. Maintain the parent artifact at CONDITION and avoid treating 0.922762x as a forecasted cash shortfall.

implementation_and_stopping.artifact_action: Record the failed decomposition and rejected proxies in the existing canonical commitment-coverage artifact; do not create a second model or dataset.
implementation_and_stopping.removed_or_avoided: Avoided a duplicate cash-timing model and unsupported AP-plus-purchase-obligation proxy.
implementation_and_stopping.restart_only_if: NVIDIA files Q3 FY2027 actuals, quantifies firm versus cancellable supply commitments, discloses supplier payment timing, or materially revises the 92B USD FY2027 bucket.
